dogecoin.text:
#Dogecoin has gained great popularity thanks to the support of influential figures such as #ElonMusk, who described it as his favorite currency & contributed to its market value rising significantly.
In May2021, its market value reached $70 billion,

#Dogecoin was launched on December 6,2013 as a joke by programmers Billy Markus &Jackson Palmer, who took inspiration from the famous #Doge meme depicting a Shiba Inu dog. The original idea is 2create a digital currency that is fun &easy 2use,
